overall_comment: The outline is highly faithful and traceable: nearly every cited number, outcome, and constraint checks out against the transcript, spans are exact, and no facts are invented. Its weaknesses are structural rather than factual: 24 units over 80 turns over-fragment two continuous work arcs (the flaky-fix cycle and the performance-optimization loop), including a single-turn unit, and five titles are truncated mid-word. As a navigational summary it is very usable, but boundary placement and title polish clearly lag the quality of the sentence-level content.
